latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the QuiverAI SVG Generation Skill.
- Generate SVGs from text prompts or vectorize raster images (PNG/JPG/WebP) using the `quiver` CLI.
- Supports commands for text-to-SVG (`generate`), image-to-SVG (`vectorize`), and listing available AI models.
- Always saves SVG output to a file for user access and provides file details upon completion.
- Includes configuration guidance for installing and authenticating the `quiver` CLI.
- Offers workflow tips for optimal SVG generation and troubleshooting common issues.
